---
title: "Research"
---

My research activity lies at the intersection of data management and artificial intelligence.

## Data Integration and Matching

Research on entity matching, schema matching, data integration quality, and table discovery.

## Explainable and Trustworthy AI

Research on interpretable entity matching and counterfactual explanations.

## Language Models for Tabular and Document Intelligence

Research on language models for reasoning over complex tables and documents.

## In-DBMS Machine Learning Inference

Research on the execution of machine learning pipelines within relational database systems.
